turns.text:
I’ll search the literature database for measured mortar records meeting both 28-day thresholds, keeping distinct the number of mixes and papers. I’ll first inspect the database schema as required.
The first detail query was rejected because the SQL safety parser interpreted a semicolon used inside a text separator as a second statement. I’ll remove that separator character and retry once.
I found 15 mortar mixes from 4 papers with measured 28-day drying-shrinkage magnitude ≤600 µstrain and 28-day compressive strength ≥50 MPa. None were 3D-printing studies.

| Published mix | Shrinkage (µstrain) | Strength (MPa) | w/b | Compression specimen |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| GOS50 | 574 | 120.03 | 0.18 | 40-mm prism |
| CA120 | 203 | 89.0 | 0.18 | 40-mm prism |
| EX-6 | 150 | 65.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| EX-L-0 | 222 | 59.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| EX-L-6 | 125 | 69.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| EX-S-6 | 192 | 63.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| EX-S-L-0 | 190 | 54.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| EX-S-L-6 | 129 | 65.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| OPC-6 | 565 | 61.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| L-0 | 518 | 55.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| L-6 | 419 | 64.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| S-6 | 407 | 52.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| S-L-0 | 379 | 52.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| S-L-6 | 343 | 61.0 | 0.40 | 50-mm cube |
| J3 | 411 | 109.4 | 0.20 | Other cube size |

Key compositions:

- GOS50: 450 kg/m³ Portland cement, 100 kg/m³ silica fume, 300 kg/m³ glass powder, 150 kg/m³ other powder, 1,000 kg/m³ standard sand, and steel fibre.
- CA120: 880 kg/m³ Portland cement, 120 kg/m³ calcium-aluminate cement, 380 kg/m³ silica fume, 150 kg/m³ Class-F fly ash, and 1,540 kg/m³ silica sand.
- EX series: 85% Portland cement and 15% calcium-sulfoaluminate cement. “S” variants contain 2% shrinkage-reducing admixture; “L” variants use 20% lightweight and 80% natural fine aggregate.
- OPC/L/S series: 100% Portland-cement binder, with the same lightweight-aggregate and shrinkage-reducer variations.
- J3, per 100 parts cement: 25 silica fume, 110 silica sand, 25 water, 2 shrinkage-reducing admixture, 1.8 PCE, and 0.5 defoamer.

Sources:

- [GOS50 paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2024.109833)
- [CA120 paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2024.111672)
- [EX/OPC/L/S series paper](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2017.12.001)
- [J3 paper](https://doi.org/10.1155/2017/6384859)

I treated shrinkage as an absolute magnitude because some database records use a negative sign for contraction. Compression specimen geometry and curing differ, so the strengths are not strictly interchangeable; any selected mix requires experimental verification under your laboratory protocol.

input.sql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT mix_uid, paper_uid, obs_uid, CAST(value_canonical AS REAL) AS shrinkage_microstrain,
         source_ref AS shrinkage_source, fig_only AS shrinkage_fig_only
  FROM measurements
  WHERE quantity='drying_shrinkage'
    AND value_canonical <> '' AND age_norm_d <> ''
    AND ABS(CAST(age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0) < 0.01
    AND CAST(value_canonical AS REAL) <= 600
), cs AS (
  SELECT m.mix_uid, m.paper_uid, m.obs_uid, CAST(m.value_canonical AS REAL) AS strength_MPa,
         m.source_ref AS strength_source, m.fig_only AS strength_fig_only,
         t.comparability_group
  FROM measurements m
  LEFT JOIN tests t ON t.test_uid=m.test_uid
  WHERE m.quantity='compressive_strength'
    AND m.value_canonical <> '' AND m.age_norm_d <> ''
    AND ABS(CAST(m.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0) < 0.01
    AND CAST(m.value_canonical AS REAL) >= 50
), eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.mix_uid, ds.paper_uid
  FROM ds JOIN cs ON cs.mix_uid=ds.mix_uid
  JOIN mixes mx ON mx.mix_uid=ds.mix_uid
  WHERE mx.system_type='mortar'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mix_uid) AS mix_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT paper_uid) AS paper_count
FROM eligible

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mx.mix_uid, mx.paper_uid
  FROM mixes mx
  JOIN measurements ds ON ds.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid
  JOIN measurements cs ON cs.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid
  WHERE mx.system_type='mortar'
    AND ds.quantity='drying_shrinkage'
    AND ds.value_canonical<>'' AND ds.age_norm_d<>''
    AND ABS(CAST(ds.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
    AND CAST(ds.value_canonical AS REAL)<=600
    AND cs.quantity='compressive_strength'
    AND cs.value_canonical<>'' AND cs.age_norm_d<>''
    AND ABS(CAST(cs.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
    AND CAST(cs.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50
)
SELECT p.year, p.title, p.doi, p.journal, p.is_3dcp_study,
       mx.mix_uid, mx.name_in_paper AS mix_name,
       mx.w_b_reported AS w_b, mx.sand_binder_ratio AS s_b, mx.curing_regime,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.value_canonical)
          FROM measurements d
         WHERE d.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND d.quantity='drying_shrinkage'
           AND d.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(d.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND d.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(d.value_canonical AS REAL)<=600) AS drying_shrinkage_28d_microstrain,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.source_ref)
          FROM measurements d
         WHERE d.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND d.quantity='drying_shrinkage'
           AND d.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(d.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND d.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(d.value_canonical AS REAL)<=600) AS shrinkage_source,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.fig_only)
          FROM measurements d
         WHERE d.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND d.quantity='drying_shrinkage'
           AND d.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(d.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND d.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(d.value_canonical AS REAL)<=600) AS shrinkage_fig_only,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.value_canonical)
          FROM measurements c
         WHERE c.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND c.quantity='compressive_strength'
           AND c.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(c.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND c.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50) AS compressive_strength_28d_MPa,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.comparability_group)
          FROM measurements c LEFT JOIN tests t ON t.test_uid=c.test_uid
         WHERE c.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND c.quantity='compressive_strength'
           AND c.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(c.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND c.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50) AS comp_specimen_group,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.source_ref)
          FROM measurements c
         WHERE c.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND c.quantity='compressive_strength'
           AND c.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(c.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND c.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50) AS strength_source,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.fig_only)
          FROM measurements c
         WHERE c.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND c.quantity='compressive_strength'
           AND c.age_norm_d<>'' AND ABS(CAST(c.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28.0)<0.01
           AND c.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50) AS strength_fig_only,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(mat.material_class || ':' ||
                 COALESCE(NULLIF(mc.mass_frac_of_binder,''),NULLIF(mc.dosage_reported,''),'?') ||
                 CASE WHEN mc.unit_reported IS NOT NULL AND mc.unit_reported<>'' THEN ' '||mc.unit_reported ELSE '' END, '; ')
          FROM mix_components mc JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
         WHERE mc.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND mc.role IN ('binder','scm')) AS binder_components
FROM eligible e
JOIN mixes mx ON mx.mix_uid=e.mix_uid
JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=e.paper_uid
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER) DESC, p.doi, mx.mix_uid

WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT mx.mix_uid, mx.paper_uid
 FROM mixes mx JOIN measurements ds ON ds.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid JOIN measurements cs ON cs.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid
 WHERE mx.system_type='mortar'
 AND ds.quantity='drying_shrinkage' AND ds.age_norm_d<>'' AND ds.value_canonical<>''
 AND ABS(CAST(ds.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND ABS(CAST(ds.value_canonical AS REAL))<=600
 AND cs.quantity='compressive_strength' AND cs.age_norm_d<>'' AND cs.value_canonical<>''
 AND ABS(CAST(cs.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND CAST(cs.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50
)
SELECT p.year,p.doi,mx.name_in_paper AS mix,mx.w_b_reported AS w_b,mx.sand_binder_ratio AS s_b,
 (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ABS(CAST(d.value_canonical AS REAL))) FROM measurements d
   WHERE d.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND d.quantity='drying_shrinkage' AND d.age_norm_d<>''
   AND ABS(CAST(d.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND d.value_canonical<>'' AND ABS(CAST(d.value_canonical AS REAL))<=600) AS shrinkage_uStrain,
 (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)) FROM measurements c
   WHERE c.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND c.quantity='compressive_strength' AND c.age_norm_d<>''
   AND ABS(CAST(c.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND c.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50) AS strength_MPa,
 (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.comparability_group) FROM measurements c LEFT JOIN tests t ON t.test_uid=c.test_uid
   WHERE c.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid AND c.quantity='compressive_strength' AND c.age_norm_d<>''
   AND ABS(CAST(c.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND c.value_canonical<>'' AND CAST(c.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50) AS specimen
FROM eligible e JOIN mixes mx ON mx.mix_uid=e.mix_uid JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=e.paper_uid
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER) DESC,p.doi,mx.mix_uid

WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT mx.mix_uid, mx.paper_uid
 FROM mixes mx JOIN measurements ds ON ds.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid JOIN measurements cs ON cs.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid
 WHERE mx.system_type='mortar'
 AND ds.quantity='drying_shrinkage' AND ds.age_norm_d<>'' AND ds.value_canonical<>''
 AND ABS(CAST(ds.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND ABS(CAST(ds.value_canonical AS REAL))<=600
 AND cs.quantity='compressive_strength' AND cs.age_norm_d<>'' AND cs.value_canonical<>''
 AND ABS(CAST(cs.age_norm_d AS REAL)-28)<0.01 AND CAST(cs.value_canonical AS REAL)>=50
)
SELECT p.doi,mx.name_in_paper AS mix,
 GROUP_CONCAT(mat.material_class||':'||COALESCE(NULLIF(mc.mass_frac_of_binder,''),NULLIF(mc.dosage_reported,''),'?')||
 CASE WHEN COALESCE(mc.unit_reported,'')<>'' THEN ' '||mc.unit_reported ELSE '' END,' + ') AS components
FROM eligible e JOIN mixes mx ON mx.mix_uid=e.mix_uid JOIN papers p ON p.paper_uid=e.paper_uid
LEFT JOIN mix_components mc ON mc.mix_uid=mx.mix_uid
LEFT JOIN materials mat ON mat.material_uid=mc.material_uid
GROUP BY p.doi,mx.mix_uid,mx.name_in_paper
ORDER BY CAST(p.year AS INTEGER) DESC,p.doi,mx.mix_uid
